title: Guild of Harwich Artists
bodyHtml:
Michael Rudden November 21, 2020

Date/Time
Date(s) - 11/21/2020
12:30 pm - 2:00 pm

Location
Harwich Community Center

Categories

  • Guild of Harwich Artists Gallery Board Meeting
  • The Art Gallery


Local nonprofit Guild of Harwich Artists will host an interactive Zoom meeting with guest artist Jay Tichenor on Saturday, November 21st after their Annual Meeting from 2:00 – 4:00 p.m. Demonstrations are free and open to the public. GHA President Michael Rudden will send Zoom invitations to the meeting on the 20th; to be included, send your name and email to info@guildofharwichartists.org.

Tichenor will be demonstrating ‘Travel Sketches’ with audience participation at home. To be prepared for the demo, you will need watercolor paper or pad of paper, a fine tip ink pen, waterproof black ink, and watercolors for a wash. Don’t have these materials? Don’t worry, join, and have fun with the Guild either way!

Celebrating its 41st year, The Guild of Harwich Artists, Inc. is a non-profit 501(c)3 organization that encourages artists and those interested in art through education, fellowship, and exhibitions, and to engage in charitable works that benefit Harwich residents.
